Hello, INV-000163 ($12.00, paid 9 March 2026) is not a duplicate, so I haven't refunded it. Your records show one successful payment on that invoice. Your other charge is a separate invoice, INV-000162 ($12.00, 7 February 2026), for the previous month.

How billing works: you are charged on the day you subscribe and on the same day each month after that. Each charge gets its own invoice, so two invoices a month apart are two separate months of service. Seats you add are charged straight away for the rest of the current period. Seats you remove stop being charged from the next renewal. If you don't want to be billed again, you can cancel under Settings > Billing > Cancel subscription (workspace owners only). Cancelling stops the next renewal.
